limitations: This slice reads the complete fields observed in Warzone 2100 4.7 for templates, structures, features, bodies, constructors, ECM, propulsion, sensors and weapons; other stats tables remain named remainder.
Model fields publish typed logical-id relations, but the common catalog-analysis ABI cannot supply the dynamic archive index or PIE documents required to prove physical model and texture paths.
Ordered workspace roots override scalar definitions by publisher key; JSON writing, localization, script execution and full multi-package archive mounting remain outside this provider.
